stemMd: A train departs every 18 minutes, beginning at 08:00. Which of these is a departure time?
explanationMd: Departure times differ from 08:00 by multiples of eighteen minutes. Seventy-two minutes is four intervals, giving 09:12. Check every proposed time against this interval rule.

distractorRationale.a: Fifty minutes is not a multiple of eighteen.
distractorRationale.b: Sixty minutes is not a multiple of eighteen.
distractorRationale.c: Eighty minutes is not a multiple of eighteen.
distractorRationale.e: Ninety-two minutes is not a multiple of eighteen.
